apply-business-rule-based-updates-across:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map (c) ->
  c update {
    case t at .tier ->
      if (t == "bronze" and c.totalSpend >= 1000) "silver"
      else if (t == "silver" and c.totalSpend >= 5000) "gold"
      else t
    case lr at .lastReviewed! -> "2024-01-01"
  }
build-erp-ready-filtered-payloads:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload filterObject ((v, k) ->
  v != null and v != "" and
  (not ((k as String) startsWith "_")) and
  (not ((k as String) endsWith "_raw"))
)
build-reusable-employee-processing-funct:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
var toSummary = (e) -> { fullName: e.firstName ++ " " ++ e.lastName, dept: e.dept }
var toPayroll = (e) -> { employeeId: e.employeeId, grossPay: e.salary, netPay: (e.salary * 0.8) as Number { format: "0.0" } as Number }
var processFn = if (payload.mode == "summary") toSummary else toPayroll
---
payload.employees map (e) -> processFn(e)
build-row-numbers-for-reports:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map ({ rowNum: $$ + 1, rowLabel: "Row-" ++ ($$ + 1 as String) } ++ $)
create-a-function-to-calculate-discounte:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
fun discountedPrice(price, discountPct) = (price - (price * discountPct / 100)) as String { format: "0.00" } as Number
---
{ finalPrice: discountedPrice(payload.price, payload.discountPct) }
create-a-function-to-generate-erp-compat:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
import capitalize from dw::core::Strings
fun erpProduct(sku, name, category, price, taxRate) =
  do {
    var listPrice = round(price * 100) / 100
    var taxAmt = round(price * taxRate) / 100
    var titleName = (name splitBy " " map capitalize($)) joinBy " "
    ---
    {
      erpSku: "ERP-" ++ upper(sku),
      displayName: titleName,
      glAccount: if (category == "services") "4000" else if (category == "goods") "5000" else "6000",
      listPrice: listPrice,
      taxAmount: taxAmt,
      netPrice: round((listPrice + taxAmt) * 100) / 100
    }
  }
---
payload.products map (p) -> erpProduct(p.sku, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.taxRate)

%dw 2.0
import capitalize from dw::core::Strings
output application/json
var formatStatus = (status) -> "[" ++ capitalize(status) ++ "]"

create-gdpr-compliant-customer-objects:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
var piiFields = ["email","phone","address","dob"]
---
do {
  var consent = payload.consentFields
  ---
  payload filterObject ((v, k) ->
    v != null and
    (k as String) != "consentFields" and
    ((not (piiFields contains (k as String))) or (consent contains (k as String)))
  )
}
create-invoice-descriptions-using-multip:
%dw 2.0
import capitalize from dw::core::Strings
output application/json
---
{
  invoiceSummary: payload.lines
    map ((l) ->
      do {
        var cleanDesc = ((l.desc replace "-" with " ") splitBy " " map capitalize($)) joinBy " "
        ---
        cleanDesc ++ " x" ++ (l.qty as String) ++ " @ \$" ++ (l.unitPrice as String)
      })
    joinBy " | "
}
create-product-tags-using-string-operati:

{ cleanTags: ((payload.rawTags splitBy ",") map (t) -> lower(trim(t))) joinBy " | " }
deduplicate-erp-transaction-payloads:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
(payload distinctBy (lower($.sourceSystem) ++ ":" ++ $.txRef ++ ":" ++ ($.amount as String)))
  map ($ ++ { dedupeKey: lower($.sourceSystem) ++ ":" ++ $.txRef ++ ":" ++ ($.amount as String) })
filter-audit-related-properties:

---
payload filterObject ((v, k) ->
  ((k as String) startsWith "audit_") or ((k as String) == "createdAt") or ((k as String) == "updatedAt")
)

%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
(payload pluck (v, k, i) -> { field: k, "type": v."type", description: v.description, example: v.example, required: v.required, fieldIndex: i + 1 }) filter $.required
group-transactions-by-region-and-type:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
(payload groupBy (tx) -> tx.region ++ "-" ++ tx.'type')
  mapObject (txs, key) -> { (key): { count: sizeOf(txs), totalAmount: sum(txs map $.amount) } }
modify-complex-invoice-and-shipment-payl:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload update {
  case s at .invoice.status -> "POSTED"
  case pd at .invoice.postedDate! -> "2024-01-01"
  case ts at .shipment.trackingStatus -> "IN_TRANSIT"
  case w at .shipment.weight -> (w * 1.1) as String { format: "0.00" } as Number

switch-between-formatting-functions-dyna:

output application/json

var shortFormat = (e) -> e.id ++ ": " ++ e.name

transform-edi-reference-values-using-inf:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map (seg) ->
  (((seg splitBy "*")
    filter ((e) -> not (e matches /^[0-9]+$/)))
    map ((e) -> e replace "-" with " "))
    joinBy ":"
